headline: Mexico Raises Gasoline Taxes for November 7-13 Week
summary: Mexico's Ministry of Finance increased the IEPS tax on automotive fuels for the week of November 7-13. The Magna gasoline quota rose to 4.96 pesos per liter and Premium to 4.27 pesos per liter, while the diesel zero-quota entered its ninth consecutive week.
why: Changes to fuel excise taxes (IEPS) directly impact domestic retail energy prices and inflation expectations in Mexico.

impacts.name: Mexico
impacts.why: Higher fuel excise taxes affect consumer inflation and transportation costs nationwide.
